title: FollowMe Algorithm Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the ArduSim2 FollowMe algorithm with specific topic routing.

role.description: Current role of the UAV in the Follow Me protocol. Must be set manually.

broker_port.description: UDP port of the Communication Module.

telemetry_topic.description: Topic to receive own telemetry from uav_controller.

suggestions_topic.description: Topic to publish movement suggestions to uav_controller.

broadcast_topic.description: Topic for Master to broadcast its position to the swarm.

subscription_topic.description: Topic to receive control commands (start, stop, pause, resume).

slaves_takeoff_altitude.title: Takeoff Altitude (m)
slaves_takeoff_altitude.description: Relative altitude reached during the initial takeoff phase.

send_period_ms.title: Broadcast Period (ms)
send_period_ms.description: Time interval between master's position broadcasts.
